Not slips: 04:12 بدأت accepted, Amal added بلشت as an alternative (chat badat/ballashat); 05:28 Amal supplied صغيرة mid-sentence (help on the way); 07:24, 07:53, 08:07, 20:17->20:23, 37:38, 42:50->42:54, 52:48->52:52 are his own self-fixes before she spoke; 09:43, 11:12, 13:12, 31:22, 1:04:29, 1:05:13 'feminine, right?', 1:08:21 'we would say singular?' are questions about the rule (he got E1 right at 1:08:21). 27:22 Amal 'Fi eish, fi eish' read as her question 'in what?' not a fix of his بإشي (her chat keeps 'bi ishi'). 34:12 مش قصدي / مش بقصد: only her chat (mish bil2a9d) differs, nothing voiced (GR-19). 46:42 من شو ضايقتي and 51:51 ما تتدايقي ـيها: engine may have dropped/added ت, Amal said yes/ممتاز, so not written. 1:09:06 his reply to يعطيك ألف عافية is not captured; Amal gave الله يعافيكي بس / ألف مرة (set phrase, cannot quote his words). 49:47-50:02 Amal first said كان بيضايق then conceded كان يضايق after he objected - the b- after kaan is left out of the row, only the ت/no-ت (B12) part is filed. 1:11:59 chat line is her write-up of his last sentence (lamma 3indna zabaayen ... aktar min talaateen sajjaade) - nothing voiced against it beyond rows 32-33.

rows.medi_said: [speaking Arabic] If I say, if I say [speaking Arabic], it wouldn't make sense? (Amal's echo: أنا لازم تصير)

rows.chat: bas ana ra7 ajrreb a5alliha t9eer muwazzafe mnee7a
rows.proposed_rule: To make / let someone become something you need a causing verb before the verb: a5alliha t9eer muwazzafe (I'll let her become an employee), not ana laazem t9eer.
rows.why: Engine has no text; Amal echoed his sentence 'أنا لازم تصير؟ No' (I must she-becomes) and told him he needs 'to make her / to let her become' = 5alla + verb; his verb also did not match his subject (ana ... t9eer).

rows.why: 'Why aren't you excited (now)' is a state, so the participle/adjective mit7ammse with mish is needed, not the verb ma btit7ammasi (= why don't you get excited, habit); Amal named the rule and he fixed it to 'Lesh mish mithamsa' (18:27). B15 is not taught yet - filed, not counted.
